'''Laselteh''', officially the '''Republic of Laselteh''', is a country in [[East Atirha]], in the [[Mii lands]]. Covering [[List of countries and dependencies by area|1,599,030 km2 (617,389 sq mi)]], it is the world's twenty-fifth-largest country by area, yet with a [[List of countries and dependencies by population|population of about 6.5 million]] it is also one of the [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|most thinly populated]], at 4.1 inhabitants per square kilometre. It is bordered by [[Gaeiya]] to the west and by [[Grazail]] and [[Etirha]] to the south, with the [[Rianian Ocean]] to the east and the [[Srandan Ocean]] to the north. Its [[wikipedia:capital city|capital]] and largest city is [[Dariya]], whose 2 million inhabitants account for close to a third of the national population. The official language is [[Estijan Language|Estijan]], and the national currency is the [[Laseltshen Kasare]].

[[Estijan]] settlement of the region began in the late 1390s with the founding of the [[Ama Koevw colony]], in what is now [[Grazail]]. The [[Mii Lands colony]] followed in 1470, and [[Dariya]] became the seat of [[Estijan Huan|Estijan]] authority in [[Atirha]]. Colonial rule ended with the [[Laseltshen Independence War]] of 1644–1647, fought as part of the [[East Atirhan wars of independence]]. Laselteh declared independence on 5 February 1647, uniting five former Estijan provinces into a single republic, and was formally recognised by [[Estijan Huan]] on 3 December 1649. Under [[Tyidai Idueria]], who succeeded [[Azraniel Barque]] as [[Supreme Director of Laselteh|Supreme Director]], discontent in the southern provinces led to the [[Backstab War]] of 1654–1655, after which Laselteh recognised the independence of [[Grazail]] under the [[Treaty of Zayden (1655)|Treaty of Zayden]]. 

Laselteh is a [[wikipedia:unitary state|unitary]] [[wikipedia:constitutional monarchy|constitutional monarchy]]. The [[Monarchy of Laselteh|monarch]] is [[wikipedia:head of state|head of state]]. The legislature, the [[Union of Laselteh]], is bicameral, comprising the [[National Assembly (Laselteh)|National Assembly]] and the [[Lainar of the People (Laselteh)|Lainar of the People]], with the [[High Minister of Laselteh|High Minister]] and the Low Minister at the head of the executive. It is among the world's most [[wikipedia:Irreligion|irreligious]] states, 89.4 per cent of the population professing no religion at the 1765 census. Despite its small population it has an [[wikipedia:Developed country|advanced economy]], with a [[List of countries by GDP (nominal) per capita|nominal GDP per capita of]] {{lahn}}197,776, the eighth-highest in the world, and it ranks [[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|20th]] on the [[Krali Development Report|Krali Total Development Index]]. That wealth rests heavily on mineral extraction: Laselteh holds the world's [[List of countries by nickel production|third-largest nickel reserves]] and is a notable producer of [[wikipedia:palladium|palladium]] and [[wikipedia:thorium|thorium]].
